# ghost/expense-tracker

My Expenses (F-Droid): add an expense or income to the local Budget Book, list the transactions, read balance/income/expenses totals. Local only, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/expense-tracker
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/expense-tracker add_expense --device <serial> --param amount=<amount>
ghost skill run ghost/expense-tracker add_income --device <serial> --param amount=<amount>
ghost skill run ghost/expense-tracker list_transactions --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/expense-tracker get_totals --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `add_expense`: Add an expense of 12.50 at the bakery for lunch
- `add_income`: Add an income of 100 from a client for a design job
- `list_transactions`: List my expenses
- `get_totals`: How much have I spent?
